history.summary: CSV TOWN FLAG: Ravangla Buddha Park is NOT in Soreng district - it stands ~1 km north of Ravangla town in NAMCHI district (South Sikkim). Documented with the corrected location. NOTE: this is a Buddhist religious-tourist PARK within the Rabong Monastery religious complex, not a temple. Its centrepiece is a 130-ft (40 m) copper Shakyamuni Buddha statue (60 tonnes, repoussage), built to mark the 2550th birth anniversary of Gautama Buddha. Constructed 2006-2013 as a state government Buddhist-circuit project and consecrated on 25 March 2013 by the 14th Dalai Lama; it is a stop on the 'Himalayan Buddhist Circuit'. The park includes Cho-Dzo lake, a meditation centre, a Buddhist conclave and a spiral-gallery museum on the life of Buddha (photography not allowed inside the statue). Nearby: Ralang Monastery and the old Rabong (Ralong) monastery.

name: Ravangla Buddha Park
town: Ravangla, Namchi district (CSV town 'Soreng' is WRONG)
town_description: Ravangla (Rabong) is a small town in Namchi district, South Sikkim, at ~7,000 ft in the Kanchenjunga foothills - a major Buddhist hub with the Buddha Park, Ralang Monastery and Tibetan settlements. The park is within walking distance of the Ravangla bus stand, amid forested hills with Himalayan views on clear days.
